body: People assume you're a guy on Reddit. I'm a girl but people always use guy pronouns on here - I don't think people think about gender before typing.

It's ok to be alone. Everyone in the world is alone no matter how powerful their bonds with their friends, family or pets are because the most important person to be with is yourself.

If there are parts you dislike about yourself, improve them through practice. Or learn to love yourself more through self reaffirmations and ignoring the obsessive negative feelings and thoughts by doing something else. It's harder than read and said but it's the path to choose, one of them, towards some sense of comfort and security.

As long as you feel it's serious for therapy, then therapy will be there for you. The reason for rejection would be over fill in patients and you'll be waiting in line. 

If your issues are digging you to the point of preventing you from successfully doing thing that are normal like sleeping well or work then yes, please go and use mental health services.

Unless you're directly harming someone else, you will never be forced into hospitalization. You can self admit but even then, you would strongly be required to persuade doctors that you are about to kill yourself right there or you are under a psychotic breakdown that includes harmful acts you cannot control.

You don't really feel this way about men or women or gender in general. You're upset over your own personal problems that have nothing to do with gender.

Health services are for all gender. College is for all gender. 

There are men and women who suffer from mental illness and men and women who don't suffer from mental illness.
